control_action: open or create a Skill Studio candidate revision
observed_behavior: Skill Studio normalizes the outer candidate ID/version but leaves capability.json, skill.yaml, and SKILL.md identity fields at the prior/default revision, so a newly opened editor fails its own preflight.
expected_behavior: Opening any new skill candidate atomically synchronizes all editable identity-bearing package files to the candidate ID/version before validation or user edits.
operational_impact: Users cannot begin from a valid Skill Studio candidate, and unrelated resource edits remain blocked by an identity mismatch the editor created itself.

discovery_evidence.claim: Browser validation reports capability.json ID and version must match the Studio revision after opening a skill draft.
normalizeSkill preserves supplied file identities and default capability.json omits version; synchronization only occurs later in studioPayload submit.

next_action: Synchronize identity-bearing editor files immediately after skill normalization and verify both fresh and loaded-package candidates.

display.detail: Preflight visibly reports the identity mismatch.

user_edit_action.detail: User can edit files, but unrelated edits cannot cure hidden identity drift.

input_validation.detail: Validator correctly rejects mismatched package identity.

runtime_effect.detail: Valid candidate save remains disabled by editor-created mismatch.

result_acknowledgement.detail: Failure is acknowledged, but the editor does not self-repair its generated identity.

failure_handling.detail: Save is fail-closed, but generated invalid state is not recovered.

reload_reopen.detail: Loaded prior package identity is not adapted to the new revision on open.

recovery_rollback.detail: Only submit-time synchronization exists, after validation already blocks progress.
